title: Tender Cream Scones with Jam and Clotted Cream
summary: Butter is rubbed into flour, baking powder and sugar, the dough is bound with egg and double cream, cut into rounds and baked hot until risen and golden.
equipment: baking tray lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
clotted cream or very thick double cream

steps.title: Rub in the butter
steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, then rub in the butter with your fingertips until it looks like fine breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Bind
steps.text: Whisk the egg into the cream, add to the bowl and stir with a knife into a soft dough. Knead 3-4 times only.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Pat out 2.5 cm thick and stamp straight down with a floured cutter; re-roll the scraps once to make 8. Brush the tops with cream.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 12-15 minutes until risen and golden, then cool 10 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Split while warm and serve with jam and clotted cream.

tips: Handle the dough as little as possible for a light, tender scone.
Cutting straight down without twisting helps them rise tall and even.
Scones are best eaten the day they are baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Warm through before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
